segments.ja277:1.1: Vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, vasimha selassa guhāya romaka;
segments.ja277:1.3: Asaṅkamānā abhinibbutattā [abhinibbutacittā (syā. ka.)], hatthatta [hatthattha (syā.)] māyanti mamaṇḍajā pure.
segments.ja277:2.1: Te dāni vakkaṅga kimatthamussukā, bhajanti aññaṃ girikandaraṃ dijā;
segments.ja277:2.3: Na nūna maññanti mamaṃ yathā pure, cirappavutthā atha vā na te ime.
segments.ja277:3.1: Jānāma taṃ na mayaṃ sampamūḷhā [na maya’ masma mūḷhā (sī. pī.)], soyeva tvaṃ te mayamasma nāññe;
segments.ja277:3.3: Cittañca te asmiṃ jane paduṭṭhaṃ, ājīvikā [ājīvaka (sī. syā.), ājīvika (pī.)] tena tamuttasāmāti.

lines: Vakkaṅgāti bodhisattaṃ ālapati, sabbepi pana pakkhino uppatanakāle gīvaṃ vakkaṃ katvā uppatanato “vakkaṅgā”ti vuccanti.
Yathā pureti yathā pubbe ete pakkhino maṃ garuṃ katvā piyaṃ katvā maññanti, tathā idāni na nūna maññanti, pubbe idha nivutthatāpaso añño, ayaṃ añño, evaṃ maññe ete maṃ maññantīti dīpeti.

Cirappavutthā atha vā na te imeti kiṃ nu kho ime ciraṃ vippavasitvā dīghassa addhuno accayena āgatattā maṃ “soyeva ayan”ti na sañjānanti, udāhu ye amhesu abhinibbutacittā, na te ime, aññeva āgantukapakkhino, ime kena maṃ na upasaṅkamantīti pucchati.
Taṃ sutvā bodhisatto pakkamitvā ṭhitova tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Jānāma taṃ na mayaṃ sampamūḷhā, soyeva tvaṃ te mayamasma nāññe;
Cittañca te asmiṃ jane paduṭṭhaṃ, ājīvikā tena tamuttasāmā”ti.
Tattha na mayaṃ sampamūḷhāti mayaṃ mūḷhā pamattā na homa.
Cittañca te asmiṃ jane paduṭṭhanti tvaṃ, soyeva mayampi teyeva, na taṃ sañjānāma, apica kho pana tava cittaṃ asmiṃ jane paduṭṭhaṃ amhe māretuṃ uppannaṃ.
Tena tamuttasāmāti tena kāraṇena taṃ uttasāma bhāyāma na upasaṅkamāma.
